builder.description: Chart key: any-engineer = engineer battalion, engineer company or HQ with engineering capability; engineer-hq = HQ with engineering capability; cw-engineer-hq = Commonwealth HQ with engineering capability; infantry-battalion-3toe = infantry-type unit with at least 3 TOE points; tank-battalion-6toe-scorpions = tank battalion holding 6+ TOE points of Scorpion flail tanks

count.description: When set, this many units drawn from the listed kinds in any mix (Benghazi: two engineer battalions and/or CW engineer HQs); otherwise all listed units together

by_units.description: false = the chart says 'not allowed': no ground unit can do it

timing.description: When the chart gives no stage count: cleared at the end of the movement segment it is entered in; destroyed on entry; or a share of the dump goes per CP spent (blowing a dump, SPI logistics rules)

also_by.description: Other things that also reduce or destroy the item

only_by.description: The only things that can destroy the item (by_units is false)

reduce_only_by.description: Causes that reduce but never destroy the item

blocked_by.description: Kinds of blocking the row covers

air_damage_automatic.description: Air bombardment damage to the item needs no roll
